name: inkwave
description: INKWAVE — an original 4v4 ink shooter. The game is the Unity build in unity/INKWAVE.

scripts.check: for f in $(find src build tools server/src -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' -o -name '*.cjs'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'syntax ok' && npm run -s unity:check
scripts.unity:check-csharp: python3 tools/unity-export/check-csharp.py && python3 tools/unity-export/check-members.py && python3 tools/unity-export/check-namespaces.py && python3 tools/unity-export/check-calls.py
